mapper.sql: select id, user_id, name, status, visible, asset_type, target_platform, aspect_ratio, quality, user_requirement, source_product_id, cover_image_id, last_task_id, created_at, updated_at from ai_product_assets
mapper.select: where user_id = #{userId} and status = 'draft_uploaded' and visible = false order by updated_at desc, created_at desc limit 1
mapper.update: update ai_product_assets set name = #{name}, status = #{status}, visible = #{visible}, asset_type = #{assetType}, target_platform = #{targetPlatform}, aspect_ratio = #{aspectRatio}, quality = #{quality}, user_requirement = #{userRequirement}, source_product_id = cast(#{sourceProductId} as uuid), cover_image_id = cast(#{coverImageId} as uuid), last_task_id = cast(#{lastTaskId} as uuid), updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = cast(#{id} as uuid) and user_id = #{userId}
